2942.title: Compact queue actions disappear at a wide viewport
2942.rootCauseOneLine: Viewport breakpoints select a transparent icon group and remove the overflow trigger inside compact embedded queues.
2942.proposedFix: Use compact queue state to show the overflow trigger at rest and hide the desktop icon group.
2942.caveats: The browser check used the trusted 318 px narrow component story in a 1200 px viewport, not a live provider turn.
